note: Pinned identities of the package repositories RetroHatch may install from (discovery/curate.py verifies them; android/.../TrustedSources.kt mirrors the URL rules). A repository's metadata is only used after its signed entry.jar verifies against the pinned certificate fingerprint and the index file matches the SHA-256 inside the signed entry.json. An APK is still checked again on the device against the SHA-256, package, versionCode and signer pinned in the signed catalog.

fdroid.name: F-Droid
fdroid.basis: F-Droid's long-standing main repository certificate (CN=Ciaran Gultnieks); matches the certificate that signs https://f-droid.org/repo/entry.jar

izzy.name: IzzyOnDroid
izzy.basis: the fingerprint printed on https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/ equals the certificate that signs https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/repo/entry.jar (two independent channels over HTTPS)
